feedback.goal: Let the operator supply the local DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to the docker-hosted harness through a workspace-root .env file: parse it in the docker runner, pass through only policy-listed names, and ship a committed .env.example with .env gitignored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The docker runner reads the workspace-root .env (KEY=VALUE, export prefix, quotes, comments) and passes policy-listed names to the container; the host process environment wins over .env.
.env.example is committed with the documented DEEPSEEK_API_KEY template and .env / .env.* are gitignored so local keys never enter VCS.

outcome.summary: .env passthrough for the docker runner shipped: host env wins, .env falls back, only docker_env_names pass through, and the template plus gitignore keep keys out of VCS.

what_worked: Values flow into the container only through -e NAME=VALUE arguments built from the policy allowlist; nothing is logged.
The parser handles the common dotenv conventions without adding a dependency.

calls.name: implement-dotenv
calls.purpose: Add loadDotEnv and env passthrough precedence to src/docker.ts; ship .env.example and gitignore rules; update the deploy runbook.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: New dotenv unit test: parsing, host-env precedence, and value-only passthrough for .env-sourced names; 7 tests in the file (2 live probes gated).
Committed template documents the cp-to-.env flow and the docker_env_names allowlist; .env and .env.* are gitignored.
Typecheck, build, 129 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

notes: Secret-handling change only; no model call, external transfer, profile change, or plugin mount was performed.
